name: PanGP-Bench
description: This initial-submission reproducibility package supports “PanGP-Bench: Release Membership and Result Comparability in Scientific Benchmarks.” It contains versioned admission contracts, 138 dataset reports, the frozen manifest, fixed split and marker evidence, fold-level results, model and analysis software, the executable SQLite evidence catalogue, independent-deposit admission code, and figure and table source data. README.txt maps the reported experiments to reproduction commands; SHA256SUMS.csv provides file checksums. Third-party raw genotype and phenotype files are available from their original providers using the recorded source links and checksums and are not redistributed in this archive.
